web_changes.screen_awake: Shared, opt-out wake assistance during file-manager activity and standalone DFU, with visible state and late-release handling.
web_changes.dfu_completion: Final acknowledgement, observed GATT disconnect and browser-requested cleanup are reported separately.
web_changes.name_and_path_errors: German and English explanations for name limits, alias collisions, reserved names and normalization, with affected name and suggested form.
web_changes.sync_changed_after_comparison: German and English messages for changed target and local contents; both stop before device mutation.
web_changes.backup_resume: Shows freshly read and revalidated reused file counts after a completed backup.

web_changes.search_preview: Inline public image from the local catalogue ID
web_changes.dfu_package_selection: Carries the selected bundled package into the DFU page.
web_changes.announcement_series_filter: Includes series with announcements only; announcements remain separate from inventory.
web_changes.figure_download_links: Explicit per-ID HTTPS links stored on this browser origin. The name button downloads only after BIN structure and public figure ID match. No Bluetooth session required.
web_changes.web_3_42_0: Home now opens figure import or firmware updates directly. If a source blocks a catalogue download, open it in the browser and check the saved BIN. Download files directly from device search results and export the checked inventory as a CSV for Excel. Illustrated shortcuts distinguish figure and firmware actions; the mobile navigation uses larger labels.
web_changes.web_3_42_1: Six workspaces have distinct accent colours. The illustrated mobile shortcuts open figure import and firmware updates. The connected-device card shows the current directory, entry count, free and total capacity, and a wide teal-to-indigo meter for used storage. Figure import keeps the first click while the view loads. The guide adds Nordic’s desktop Bluetooth DFU option and adapter requirements. README screenshots illustrate simulated device data.
web_changes.web_3_42_2: Compact figure-import and firmware-update shortcuts. The file manager links its source and review ZIPs. Versioned Pages URLs and release documentation provide both archives for web 3.42.2 and 3.42.1.
web_changes.web_3_43_0: Optional restartable folder backups, per-browser catalogue favourites and named filters, JSON link import and export, 180-degree LCD PNG rotation, translated preparation errors, lazy ZIP reader and DE3.67/639 in the LCD test channel.
web_changes.web_3_43_1: The local LittleFS capacity check shows DE3.67 with application counter 639 as the latest verified firmware. This storage profile covers DE3.55 through DE3.67.
web_changes.web_3_44_0: When you open the file manager, it selects the first supported language in your browser’s preference list. Use the language menu to choose a fixed language or return to automatic selection.
web_changes.web_3_45_0: Game compatibility filters, owned figures, dated announcements and a two-way folder comparison. Optional local device nicknames on supported Web Bluetooth sessions.
web_changes.web_3_46_0: Open each published LCD application package in Nordic DFU on Android. Compare two complete backup ZIPs offline.
